correctness.rationale: For arbitrary complex positive-definite f, taking real parts and dihedral averaging preserves support, f(0), Fourier positivity, and mass. Fourier normalization is checked with counting measure; the three-orbit polynomial P is derived by explicit Fourier expansion. f0=1_B1*1_-B1/5 has f0(0)=1, mass five, and Fourier transform (1+2x+2y)^2/5. At 5|n a pentagonal grid contact gives P=1-a-b-c; at 12|n the two contacts give 1-a+b-2c and 1-a-3b whose mean is 1-a-b-c, proving sharp upper bounds. Lam–Leung Corollary 3.4 and Theorem 4.8 rigorously restrict every vanishing five-root sum to pentagon or 2+3 cycles, leaving only grid zeros at 5-,6-,12-fold contacts; the inverse-pair symmetry removes other 2+3 types. If 5 and 6 do not divide n, P0 has a positive finite minimum and (1+epsilon)f0-epsilon delta0 strictly improves the mass while preserving positivity. If 6|n but 5,12 do not, the direction (a,b,c)=(2/5,1/5,2/5)+epsilon(1,3,1) has Fourier derivative zero at the only P0 zero samples, and is positive elsewhere for sufficiently small epsilon; mass strictly rises. These cases exhaust n>=5. Exact rational n=6 witness (3/7,2/7,3/7) has mass 39/7 and nonnegative Fourier values. Supplementary standalone checker passed n=5..240 tests. No claim of an exact excess formula or a complete optimizer classification.

originality.rationale: The final statement gives an all-order exact equality criterion for a fixed, naturally motivated thirteen-point Lee support on square cyclic tori. Material inspection of Kolountzakis–Révész (2003) Theorems 2/4 and Berdysheva–Révész (2019) Theorem 1.1 found general positive-type Turán/packing bounds but not this 5-versus-strict divisibility characterization; their statements do not produce both the 12-fold two-contact certificate and the strict sixfold tangential perturbation. The closest specifically inspected finite cyclic support calculation concerns one-dimensional five-point frequencies, and a Boolean-shell record uses a different group and support. Lam–Leung implies only the cyclotomic zero classification, not the positive-definite optimization. Searches were nonexhaustive and cannot rule out unindexed equivalent work.

value.rationale: The support B2=B1-B1 is the first nontrivial two-dimensional Lee metric neighborhood arising as the autocorrelation of the canonical five-point cross, making the baseline five mathematically natural, not an arbitrary slice. Whether this standard positive-definite benchmark stays globally extremal is a motivated sharpness question in Turán/Delsarte analysis. The exact characterization by two distinct cyclotomic divisibility patterns (5 and 12), and a strictly positive excess at all other sizes including the tangential sixfold case, determines an infinite-family natural invariant threshold. This is structural finite-harmonic analysis, not a small numerical improvement or routine table recomputation. The value does not depend on resolving the remaining exact excess values.
